name: nextschool-attendance-operations
description: A production-minded school attendance REST API and administrative dashboard built with NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and TypeScript.

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nextschool/api && npm run build -w @nextschool/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nextschool/api && npm run typecheck -w @nextschool/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nextschool/api && npm run lint -w @nextschool/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
